faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Health Society Thanjavur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Health Society Thanjavur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for TB Health Visitor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Health Society Thanjavur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Thanjavur district website (thanjavur.nic.in); form also printed as page 2 of the notice) and send it to Deputy Director of Medical Services (TB), District TB Centre, Raja Mirasudar Hospital Campus, Thanjavur-613001, by by post / in person, to reach by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 60 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 15000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate in Science OR Intermediate (10+2) in Science with experience as MPW/LHV/ANM/Health worker / certificate or higher course in health education/Counseling OR Tuberculosis Health Visitor's recognized course; and certificate course in computer operation (minimum two months).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only permanent residents of Thanjavur district are eligible to apply. Must be willing to work at the required place in Thanjavur district. Certificate course in computer operation of minimum two months is essential.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Persons not permanently residing in Thanjavur district.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on the basis of qualification. Interview. Applicants will be called for interview on the basis of qualification.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary post on contract basis. Tenure of 11 months. Post will be renewed for the next 11 months based on performance.
